title: Home — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21). COMPLETE 2026-07-29. Home is a single-route dashboard with no tab strip — its surfaces are sections of one page, all of which rendered in both entities during the live check. Unlike ELD/Insurance/Cash Flow/Compliance, there was no hidden tab layer to grow M with, so the module genuinely closes on one item. It reopens the moment a section is found broken (Rule 21: M grows when new FAILs appear).
